payload.name: Preserve-all-alternatives-in-extraction
payload.description: When extracting a memory from a message that lists multiple alternatives (e.g., 'or', 'and', comma-separated options), capture every listed option; do not drop any item.
content: During extraction, if a message names multiple alternative options, suggestions, or list items connected by 'or', 'and', or commas, the candidate memory content must include every listed item, not only the first or most prominent one.
Before finalizing a candidate, scan the full message for enumerated alternatives and verify that each one is represented in the content; a later query may target any individual item.

When updating an existing memory, if the source message still supports an alternative that is present in the current memory, do not remove that alternative unless the source explicitly retracts or contradicts it.

solves: Diagnosed failure: an extraction candidate captured only 'biking' from a message suggesting 'biking or using public transport', so the memory lacked the public transport option and the claim was MISSING. The rule to preserve all alternatives in a single message transfers to any future input containing lists, options, or suggestions with multiple items, preventing partial memory extractions.
